license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, partnership, limited liability company, association, or corporation to engage in the business or capacity of real estate broker in this state without first having obtained a license from the commission.

issuing_authority.quote: There is created a commission of five members, appointed by the governor, which shall administer parts 2 and 5 of this article 10. This commission is known as the real estate commission.

name.quote: This commission is known as the real estate commission.

type.quote: There is created a commission of five members, appointed by the governor, which shall administer parts 2 and 5 of this article 10. This commission is known as the real estate commission.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Real Estate, Department of Regulatory Agencies
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created in the department the division of real estate.

age_minimum.quote: An applicant for a broker's license shall be at least eighteen years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: The commission is authorized by this section to require and procure any such proof as is necessary in reference to the truthfulness, honesty, and good moral character of any applicant for a real estate broker's license

degree_required.value: Accredited degree with major in real estate, OR 168 hours of approved real estate coursework (48 hrs real estate law/practice + 48 hrs Colorado contracts + 72 hrs from trust accounts, closings, legal issues, practical applications)
degree_required.quote: the applicant has either received a degree from an accredited degree-granting college or university with a major course of study in real estate or has successfully completed courses of study, approved by the commission, at any accredited college or university or any private occupational school

accrediting_body.value: accredited college or university or private occupational school approved by commission
accrediting_body.quote: at any accredited college or university or any private occupational school that has a certificate of approval from the private occupational school division in accordance with the provisions of article 64 of title 23 or that has been approved by the commission or licensed by an official state agency of any other state

degree_level.quote: the applicant has either received a degree from an accredited degree-granting college or university with a major course of study in real estate or has successfully completed courses of study, approved by the commission

school_approval_basis.quote: at any accredited college or university or any private occupational school that has a certificate of approval from the private occupational school division in accordance with the provisions of article 64 of title 23 or that has been approved by the commission

credential_pegged.quote: the applicant has either received a degree from an accredited degree-granting college or university with a major course of study in real estate or has successfully completed courses of study, approved by the commission

required.quote: No such broker shall engage in an independent brokerage practice without first having served actively as a real estate broker for at least two years.

experience_source.quote: No such broker shall engage in an independent brokerage practice without first having served actively as a real estate broker for at least two years.

duration.quote: No such broker shall engage in an independent brokerage practice without first having served actively as a real estate broker for at least two years.

kind.value: active real estate broker practice (required before independent brokerage; also 24 hours brokerage administration before employing others)
kind.quote: No such broker shall engage in an independent brokerage practice without first having served actively as a real estate broker for at least two years. The commission shall adopt rules requiring an employing broker to ensure that a high level of supervision is exercised over such a broker during the two-year period.

exams.name: Colorado Real Estate Broker Examination
exams.notes: Covers ethics, reading, spelling, basic mathematics, land economics, appraisal, financing, Colorado statutes relating to deeds, trust deeds, mortgages, listing contracts, contracts of sale, bills of sale, leases, agency, brokerage, trust accounts, closings, securities, and preparation of a real estate closing statement. Out-of-state licensees with 2+ years may obtain license by equivalency. Licensed attorneys must complete 12 hours of instruction in trust accounts, record keeping, and real estate closings before taking exam.
exams.quote: The applicant for a broker's license shall submit to and pass an examination designated to determine the competency of the applicant and prepared by or under the supervision of the commission or its designated contractor.

interval_years.quote: the commission shall require that any person licensed under this part 2, whether on an active or inactive basis, renew the license on or before December 31 of every third year after issuance

required.quote: Renewal is conditioned upon fulfillment of the continuing education requirements set forth in section 12-10-213.

hours_per_period.quote: completion of a minimum of twenty-four hours of credit, twelve of which must be the credits developed by the commission pursuant to subsection (2) of this section

period_years.quote: For licensees applying for renewal of a three-year license, passage within the previous three years of the Colorado portion of the real estate exam or completion of a minimum of twenty-four hours of credit

value: 12 hours commission-developed credits (update of current statutes and rules affecting real estate practice)
12 hours elective from approved subjects (real estate law, contracts, finance, appraisal, closings, ethics, etc.)
topical_requirements.quote: twelve of which must be the credits developed by the commission pursuant to subsection (2) of this section

available.quote: An applicant for a broker's license who has held a real estate license in another jurisdiction that administers a real estate broker's examination and who has been licensed for two or more years prior to applying for a Colorado license may be issued a broker's license if the applicant establishes that he or she possesses credentials and qualifications that are substantively equivalent to the requirements in Colorado for licensure by examination.

requirements.value: Out-of-state broker licensees with 2+ years of licensure may qualify by demonstrating substantively equivalent credentials. Reduced pre-license education: out-of-state brokers need only complete Colorado contracts course and specified subjects; out-of-state salespersons need contracts and additional specified subjects. Nonresidents not required to maintain in-state place of business if they maintain a definite place of business in another state.
requirements.quote: An applicant for a broker's license who has held a real estate license in another jurisdiction that administers a real estate broker's examination and who has been licensed for two or more years prior to applying for a Colorado license may be issued a broker's license if the applicant establishes that he or she possesses credentials and qualifications that are substantively equivalent to the requirements in Colorado for licensure by examination.

exists.quote: There is created a commission of five members, appointed by the governor, which shall administer parts 2 and 5 of this article 10. This commission is known as the real estate commission.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, partnership, limited liability company, association, or corporation to engage in the business or capacity of real estate broker in this state without first having obtained a license from the commission.

credential_type.quote: All persons desiring to become real estate brokers shall apply to the commission for a license under the provisions of this part 2.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, partnership, limited liability company, association, or corporation to engage in the business or capacity of real estate broker in this state without first having obtained a license from the commission.

title_protection.quote: No person shall be licensed as a real estate broker under more than one name, and no person shall conduct or promote a real estate brokerage business except under the name under which the person is licensed.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, partnership, limited liability company, association, or corporation to engage in the business or capacity of real estate broker in this state without first having obtained a license from the commission.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making misrepresentations or using false or misleading advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making any misrepresentation or knowingly making use of any false or misleading advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making promises that influence or induce others when the licensee could not or did not intend to keep them
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any promise of a character that influences, persuades, or induces another person when he or she could not or did not intend to keep the promise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly misrepresenting or making false promises through agents, advertising, or otherwise
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly misrepresenting or making false promises through agents, advertising, or otherwise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the Colorado Consumer Protection Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of the "Colorado Consumer Protection Act", article 1 of title 6

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge of all parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting for more than one party in a transaction without the knowledge of all parties thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing or attempting to represent another broker without the express knowledge and consent of the licensee's employer
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing or attempting to represent a real estate broker other than the licensee's employer without the express knowledge and consent of that employer

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to place deposits in the custody of the broker-employer as soon as practicably possible
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to place, as soon after receipt as is practicably possible, in the custody of that licensed broker-employer any deposit money or other money or fund entrusted to the employee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to account for or remit money belonging to others within a reasonable time, or failing to keep records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to account for or to remit, within a reasonable time, any money coming into the licensee's possession that belongs to others

disciplinary_grounds.description: Converting, diverting, or commingling funds of others with the broker's own funds, or failing to keep funds in escrow or trustee account
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Converting funds of others, diverting funds of others without proper authorization, commingling funds of others with the broker's own funds, or failing to keep the funds of others in an escrow or a trustee account

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide purchaser and seller with a closing statement or signed duplicate copies of listing/sale contracts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide the purchaser and seller of real estate with a closing statement of the transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain documents or records for four years or to produce them upon request
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain possession, for future use or inspection by an authorized representative of the commission, for a period of four years, of the documents or records prescribed by the rules of the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a commission or valuable consideration for real estate brokerage acts to any unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying a commission or valuable consideration for performing any of the functions of a real estate broker, as described in this part 2, to any person not licensed under this part 2

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarding or violating any provision of this part 2 or commission rules, or aiding and abetting such violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disregarding or violating any provision of this part 2 or part 4 of this article 10, violating any reasonable rule promulgated by the commission

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of, or plea to, specified crimes including crimes of violence, theft, fraud, and drug offenses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of, entering a plea of guilty to, or entering a plea of nolo contendere to any crime in article 3 of title 18

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or aiding and abetting violation of Colorado or federal fair housing laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or aiding and abetting in the violation of the Colorado or federal fair housing laws

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to immediately notify the commission in writing of a conviction or fair housing violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to immediately notify the commission in writing of a conviction, plea, or violation pursuant to subsection (1)(n) or (1)(o) of this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Demonstrated unworthiness or incompetency to act as a real estate broker in a manner that endangers the public interest
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having demonstrated unworthiness or incompetency to act as a real estate broker by conducting business in such a manner as to endanger the interest of the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to exercise reasonable supervision over the activities of licensed employees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a broker licensee, failing to exercise reasonable supervision over the activities of licensed employees

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by fraud, misrepresentation, deceit, or material misstatement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, or attempting to procure, a real estate broker's license or renewing, reinstating, or reactivating, or attempting to renew, reinstate, or reactivate, a real estate broker's license by fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit or by making a material misstatement of fact in an application for the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Claiming, arranging for, or taking any secret or undisclosed compensation or failing to reveal full compensation to principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Claiming, arranging for, or taking any secret or undisclosed amount of compensation, commission, or profit or failing to reveal to the licensee's principal or employer the full amount of the licensee's compensation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using an option to purchase in a listing agreement without prior written disclosure of profit to principal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using any provision allowing the licensee an option to purchase in any agreement authorizing or employing the licensee to sell, buy, or exchange real estate for compensation or commission, except when the licensee, prior to or coincident with election to exercise the option to purchase, reveals in writing to the licensee's principal or employer the full amount of the licensee's profit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, misrepresentation, deceit, or conversion of trust funds resulting in a civil judgment for damages (on/after August 26, 2013)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Effective on and after August 26, 2013, fraud, misrepresentation, deceit, or conversion of trust funds that results in the entry of a civil judgment for damages

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other conduct constituting dishonest dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct, whether of the same or a different character than specified in this subsection (1), that constitutes dishonest dealing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having had a real estate broker's or subdivision developer's license suspended or revoked in any other jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having had a real estate broker's or a subdivision developer's license suspended or revoked in any jurisdiction, or having had any disciplinary action taken against the broker or subdivision developer in any other jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to keep records documenting proof of completion of continuing education requirements for four years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to keep records documenting proof of completion of the continuing education requirements in accordance with section 12-10-213 for a period of four years from the date of compliance with the section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the affiliated business arrangement disclosure requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of section 12-10-218.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Within the last five years, having a license revoked or suspended for fraud, deceit, misrepresentation, theft, or breach of fiduciary duty in specified regulated professions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Within the last five years, having a license, registration, or certification issued by Colorado or another state revoked or suspended for fraud, deceit, material misrepresentation, theft, or the breach of a fiduciary duty

insurance_required.quote: Every licensee under this part 2, except an inactive broker or an attorney licensee who maintains a policy of professional malpractice insurance that provides coverage for errors and omissions for their activities as a licensee under this part 2, shall maintain errors and omissions insurance to cover all activities contemplated under parts 2 to 6 of this article 10.

definition_quote.value: Real estate broker or broker means any person, firm, partnership, limited liability company, association, or corporation that, in consideration of compensation by fee, commission, salary, or anything of value or with the intention of receiving or collecting such compensation, engages in or offers or attempts to engage in, either directly or indirectly, by a continuing course of conduct or by any single act or transaction, any of the following acts: Selling, exchanging, buying, renting, or leasing real estate, or interest therein, or improvements affixed thereon; Offering to sell, exchange, buy, rent, or lease real estate...
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate broker" or "broker" means any person, firm, partnership, limited liability company, association, or corporation that, in consideration of compensation by fee, commission, salary, or anything of value or with the intention of receiving or collecting such compensation, engages in or offers or attempts to engage in, either directly or indirectly, by a continuing course of conduct or by any single act or transaction

value: Selling, exchanging, buying, renting, or leasing real estate or interests therein
Offering to sell, exchange, buy, rent, or lease real estate
Selling or offering to sell or exchange an existing lease of real estate
Negotiating the purchase, sale, or exchange of real estate
Listing, offering, attempting, or agreeing to list real estate for sale, exchange, rent, or lease
Auctioning or offering to auction real estate
Buying, selling, or dealing in options on real estate or acting as an option dealer
Performing any of the foregoing acts as an employee of or on behalf of the owner
Negotiating the listing, sale, purchase, exchange, or lease of a business involving real estate
Soliciting a fee from a prospective tenant for furnishing information concerning availability of real property
methods_authorized.quote: Selling, exchanging, buying, renting, or leasing real estate, or interest therein, or improvements affixed thereon; Offering to sell, exchange, buy, rent, or lease real estate, or interest therein, or improvements affixed thereon; Selling or offering to sell or exchange an existing lease of real estate; Negotiating the purchase, sale, or exchange of real estate; Listing, offering, attempting, or agreeing to list real estate; Auctioning or offering, attempting, or agreeing to auction real estate; Buying, selling, offering to buy or sell, or otherwise dealing in options on real estate

value: Individual broker
Partnership broker
Limited liability company broker
Corporation broker
Employing broker
Employed broker (registered as in employ of another broker)
license_tiers.quote: Real estate brokers' licenses may be granted to individuals, partnerships, limited liability companies, or corporations.

broker_of_record_required.quote: A partnership, limited liability company, or corporation, in its application for a license, shall designate a qualified, active broker to be responsible for management and supervision of the licensed actions of the partnership, limited liability company, or corporation and all licensees shown in the commission's records as being in the employ of the entity.

pre_exam_instruction_hours.quote: Forty-eight hours of classroom instruction or equivalent correspondent hours in real estate law and real estate practice; and Forty-eight hours of classroom instruction or equivalent correspondent hours in understanding and preparation of Colorado real estate contracts; and A total of seventy-two hours of instruction or equivalent correspondence hours from the following areas of study

value: Real estate law and real estate practice (48 hours)
Understanding and preparation of Colorado real estate contracts (48 hours)
Trust accounts and record keeping
Real estate closings
Current legal issues
Practical applications
required_instruction_topics.quote: Forty-eight hours of classroom instruction or equivalent correspondent hours in real estate law and real estate practice; and Forty-eight hours of classroom instruction or equivalent correspondent hours in understanding and preparation of Colorado real estate contracts; and A total of seventy-two hours of instruction or equivalent correspondence hours from the following areas of study: Trust accounts and record keeping; Real estate closings; Current legal issues; and Practical applications.

exam_application_window_years.quote: Failure by the person taking an examination to file the appropriate broker's application within one year of the date the person passed the examination will automatically cancel the examination, and all rights to a passing score will be terminated.

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: Any application for licensure from a person whose license has been revoked shall not be considered until the passage of one year from the date of revocation.

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: Failing to maintain possession, for future use or inspection by an authorized representative of the commission, for a period of four years, of the documents or records prescribed by the rules of the commission

escrow_account_required.quote: failing to keep the funds of others in an escrow or a trustee account with some bank or recognized depository in this state, which account may be any type of checking, demand, passbook, or statement account insured by an agency of the United States government

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: Converting funds of others, diverting funds of others without proper authorization, commingling funds of others with the broker's own funds

fixed_office_required.quote: Every real estate broker licensed under this part 2 shall maintain a place of business within this state, except as provided in section 12-10-208.

branch_office_associate_broker_required.quote: In case a real estate broker maintains more than one place of business within the state, the broker shall be responsible for supervising all licensed activities originating in the offices.

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: It is unlawful for any such licensee to perform any of the acts authorized under the license in pursuance of this part 2, either directly or indirectly, on or after the date that employment has been terminated.

value: Attorney-in-fact acting without compensation under a power of attorney
Public official in the conduct of official duties
Receiver, trustee, administrator, conservator, executor, or guardian acting under proper authorization
Person acting personally or corporation acting through officers/salaried employees on behalf of itself as principal
Attorney-at-law in connection with representation of clients in practice of law
Persons negotiating or dealing in oil and gas or other mineral leases/interests for pipeline purposes
Natural person acting with respect to property owned or leased by that person, or general partner/manager/20%+ owner authorized to sell partnership/LLC property
Corporation acting through officers/salaried employees with respect to its own non-real-estate business property
Principal officer of a corporation owning 20%+ stock with respect to property owned by it (not applicable to corporations selling previously occupied 1- and 2-family dwellings)

Sole proprietor/corporation/partnership/LLC acting through its officers with respect to new commercial/industrial/residential property not previously occupied where consideration includes cost of building
Corporation/partnership/LLC acting through officers/employees with respect to shopping center, office building, or industrial park sold in ordinary course of business
Regularly salaried employee of apartment building/complex owner acting as on-site manager
Regularly salaried employee of condominium unit owner acting as on-site manager
Real estate broker licensed in another state receiving a share of commission or finder's fee on a cooperative transaction from a licensed Colorado broker
Sole proprietor/corporation/partnership/LLC selling property where purchaser is in the business of developing land

Persons negotiating or acquiring rights-of-way for telecommunication lines, wireless communication facilities, CATV, electric lines, water systems, and transportation projects (excluding representation of displaced persons in residential/commercial relocations)
license_exemptions.quote: "Real estate broker" or "broker" does not apply to any of the following: Any attorney-in-fact acting without compensation under a power of attorney... Any public official in the conduct of his or her official duties... Any receiver, trustee, administrator, conservator, executor, or guardian acting under proper authorization...
